name: SCD41 CO2 sensor
description: Sensirion photoacoustic NDIR CO2 sensor (specified 400-5000 ppm, ±(50 ppm + 2.5 %) from 400-1000 ppm, output 0-40000 ppm) with on-board temperature and relative humidity, I2C interface. Unlike the SCD40 it also has an on-demand single shot mode (one reading in 5 s, 0.5 mA average at one reading per 5 min). Chip runs on 2.4-5.5 V. Sold as: Adafruit SCD-41 STEMMA QT breakout (PID 5190; 5-pin header VIN, 3Vo, GND, SCL, SDA, 3-5 V supply), I2C address 0x62 (fixed).
eli5: Measures how much carbon dioxide is in the room, so you can tell when it is time to open a window. It can sleep between readings to save battery.

pins.name: VIN
pins.description: Supply, 3-5 V (use your board's logic voltage; an on-board regulator makes 3.3 V)

pins.name: 3Vo
pins.description: 3.3 V OUTPUT of the on-board regulator (up to 100 mA), not an input: leave unconnected

pins.name: SCL
pins.description: I2C clock (10 k pull-up on the board)

pins.name: SDA
pins.description: I2C data (10 k pull-up on the board)

buildNotes: Send stop_periodic_measurement (0x3F86) and wait 500 ms so the sensor is idle. Then for each reading send measure_single_shot (0x219D) and wait 5000 ms.
Check get_data_ready_status (0xE4B8): ready when the low 11 bits of the word are not 0. Then read_measurement (0xEC05) returns 9 bytes: CO2, temperature, humidity words, each followed by a CRC.
CO2 [ppm] = word0; T = -45 + 175 x word1 / 65535 °C; RH = 100 x word2 / 65535 %. CRC-8 poly 0x31, init 0xFF.
After a power cycle (or wake_up) the first single shot reading should be discarded; the driver does this, so the first read() takes about 10 s.
Peak current is about 205 mA during each measurement pulse at 3.3 V: use a solid supply, the sensor needs ripple under 30 mV.
Automatic self-calibration in single shot mode is tuned for one reading every 5 minutes and needs fresh outdoor air (about 400 ppm) now and then.
Do not touch the sensor's membrane; keep it away from the regulator and microcontroller, which warm the air.

example.code:
from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
from scd41 import SCD41

i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}))
sensor = SCD41(i2c)
while True:
    co2, t, h = sensor.read()  # single shot: about 5 s (10 s the first time)
    print('CO2=%dppm T=%.1fC H=%.0f%%' % (co2, t, h))
    time.sleep(1)

test.title: Reports the CO2, temperature and humidity set on the sliders
